column1: Maria de las Mercedes Moratorio Lerena
# *** 1. JOSEFA LERENA, WIFE OF FERNANDO MORATORIO, IS THE DAUGHTER OF AVELINO LERENA AND AMBROSIA
# TRAIBEL. *** That is Josefa Lerena Traibel, born 1851, died Montevideo 1947 aged ninety-six. The
# link between the Moratorio marriage and the Lerena Traibel woman was a FamilySearch TREE
# ATTACHMENT - secondary, and exactly the kind of thing this archive refuses to build on. It is now
# a parish act naming the grandparents.
# *** 2. SO SHE MARRIED A MORATORIO, NOT A LERENA - AND MY CENSUS READING IS DEAD. ***
# Earlier on 14 September this archive published that the 1895 Buenos Aires census line "LERENA de L.
# JOSEFA" showed a Lerena woman married to a Lerena man, and called it "the pattern the whole search
# turns on". It was withdrawn within the hour on the strength of a tree attachment. *** It is now
# withdrawn on the strength of a document. *** "de L." is the enumerator's shorthand for the LERENA
# HOUSEHOLD, not the husband's surname.
# (Strictly: that the census Josefa IS this Josefa remains an inference - from her age, 43 in 1895
# against a birth of 1851, and from her being a VIUDA where a 1922-25 marriage record describes
# Fernando Moratorio as "fallecido". Strong, and still an inference.)
# *** 3. A NEW LERENA WOMAN: MERCEDES. *** She stood godmother to one of the two sisters. A Lerena at
# the font of a Lerena Traibel child is very likely another daughter of Avelino and Ambrosia - a
# sister of Josefa. Nothing else in this archive names her.
# Also new, and belonging to the Moratorio side: FERNANDO MORATORIO the elder and NICOLASA TORRES.
# ============ THE PLATE, OPENED 21 SEPTEMBER 2026 - AND THE TWINS ARE TWINS ============
# Film *** 007713378, image 02598 ***, folios 411-412. IMAGE READ.
# *** BOTH ACTS STATE THE SAME BIRTH DATE, AND IT IS THE TEST THIS ARCHIVE SAID WAS CHEAP AND
# NEVER RAN: ***
#   Maria Carlota:           'que nacio el VEINTE Y CUATRO DE FEBRERO ultimo'
#   Maria de las Mercedes:   'que nacio el veinte y cuatro de Febrero ultimo'
# *** BORN 24 FEBRUARY 1880, BAPTISED 8 MARCH, TWELVE DAYS OLD. They are twins. ***
# *** AND THAT IS THE OPPOSITE ANSWER TO THE ONE THE SAME REASONING GOT IN 1858. *** Ana Rosario
# and Alfredo Justiniano Lerena Traibel were carried to the font at San Francisco de Asis on one
# morning and were born TWENTY-ONE MONTHS APART. This archive inferred twins there, was refuted by
# the acts, and then flagged the 1880 pair as resting on the same bad reasoning. *** The flag was
# right and the conclusion it doubted was also right. *** A shared baptism date means nothing on
# its own; it happened to mean twins this time. Which is the argument for reading the page rather
# than arguing from the habit in either direction.
# *** THE GODPARENTS ARE TWO DIFFERENT PAIRS, which this archive had not established: ***
#   Maria Carlota          - FRANCISCO AZANOLA and MANUELA OTONDO
#   Maria de las Mercedes  - JUAN [ARECHAGA] and MERCEDES LERENA
# Both acts give 'abuelos paternos FERNANDO y NICOLASA TORRES', 'abuelos maternos AVELINO y
# AMBROSIA TRAIBEL', and the parents as *** ORIENTALES ***. The officiant is Don SILVERIO VINALS
# 'con licencia del infrascripto Cura Parroco', and the signature on both is *** RAFAEL YEREGUI ***.
# *** AND THE OTHER TEST ON THIS PLATE CAME BACK EMPTY, WHICH IS ALSO AN ANSWER. *** The register
# row for MERCEDES LERENA (godmother, 1880) said she could be joined to Mercedes Micaela Lerena
# Traibel only if the act gave 'her age or her parentage'. *** It gives neither. *** The two rows
# stay apart - but the reason is now a page that was read, not a page that was never opened.
# *** AND THE PARISH IN THIS FILE WAS WRONG FOR A WEEK. *** Corrected 21 September 2026 off the
# plate. Both acts read: 'Don SILVERIO VINALS, con licencia del infrascripto Cura Parroco DE ESTA
# BASILICA MENOR Y CATEDRAL DE MONTEVIDEO, bautice solemnemente EN ELLA a ...'.
# *** THEY WERE BAPTISED IN THE CATEDRAL BASILICA. The UNION came from the INDEX's place field, ***
# which this archive copied without noticing it was metadata rather than testimony. *** And the
# error had grown a conclusion on it: *** /uruguay/ said Avelino Pedro Joaquin Silvestre was
# christened at the Union in 1866 'the same parish where his cousins the Moratorio girls were
# baptised fourteen years later'. *** That sentence was built on a place nobody had read. ***
